svg.text: AirControl: the pinch A, mirrored, and a variant
Both are exactly mirror-symmetric about the centre line. The right finger is the left one flipped, not redrawn.

g.text: Same idea, now exactly symmetric: the right finger is the left one flipped through the centre
line, the gap and the dot sit on it, and the mark is centred in its box.
The crossbar is the pointer you see on screen, a ring with a dot. The two legs are the arcs that
close in on it when your thumb and index come together.
